title: EarningsDate
description: obs.earnings_date r1: one answer about the next earnings date of one issuer on one day; append only, an error is a row and a later success is a new attempt.

observed_on.description: Session day (XNYS) the row answers for.

issuer.description: The issuer text of the watch list: cik:<10 digits>, or edinet:<code>.

attempt.description: Attempt number of the day, from 1; a later attempt never replaces an earlier row.

symbol.description: Symbol as the vendor or the watch list gave it.

status.description: listed: the source gave a date; absent: the source has no date for the issuer; unsupported: no source covers the issuer; error: the source failed. Only listed carries a report_date.

report_date.description: Earliest listed date on or after observed_on; null unless status is listed. The key is always present.

fiscal_period_end.description: End of the fiscal period the report covers; null when the source does not say.

time_of_day.description: Time text of the source, for example pre-market or post-market; empty when none.

estimate.description: Estimate of the source as decimal text, currency not stored; null when none.

error_code.description: Error code when status is error, for example rate_limited; empty otherwise.

source.description: Where the row came from; owner is a report_date_override (the only row of that issuer that day, attempt 1); none is a status unsupported row, since no source produced it. Never null.

received_at.description: Instant the row was produced, UTC.
